summary: Static architecture: Astro frontend, None backend, None database on Netlify.

frontend.justification: SEO-critical pages need server-side rendering / pre-rendering; matches team language(s): javascript, html, css; well suited to content_site. Ships zero JS by default; islands for interactivity. Ideal for content and SEO-critical sites.

alternatives.why_not: Weaker server-side rendering for SEO-critical pages.
Heavier to operate; higher running cost for a cost-sensitive project; weaker server-side rendering for SEO-critical pages.
Heavier to operate; higher running cost for a cost-sensitive project.

backend.justification: Pure content site with no auth, payments, uploads or realtime: a static build plus managed form/comment services covers it, so no custom backend is warranted.

database.justification: No accounts, uploads or transactions: content can live in the repository/build pipeline, so no database server is justified.

hosting.justification: First-class support for the chosen framework(s); free tier fits the $0 budget; no DevOps capacity, so a managed platform keeps operations near zero. Static + serverless functions with a generous free tier; no India region.

alternatives.why_not: Scored lower on this scenario's specific priorities and constraints.
Scored lower on this scenario's specific priorities and constraints.
Scored lower on this scenario's specific priorities and constraints.

tradeoffs: No India region; serverless-only compute model.

supporting.justification: Free-tier CDN, caching, WAF and DDoS protection.
CI/CD next to the code; free tier covers small teams.
Error monitoring with a free tier; self-hostable if needed.

assumptions: Netlify free tier covers the launch load
All components on free tiers; small buffer for overage or a custom domain
Order-of-magnitude band, not a quote; real bills depend on traffic shape and discounts
